text: JavaFX-first JVM decision: use supported TriangleMesh, POINT_NORMAL_TEXCOORD face mappings, a chunked per-face PixelBuffer atlas, PhongMaterial lit/unlit modes, and PickResult. Do not depend on internal Prism shader APIs. The feasibility child is a hard admission gate; if it fails correctness or measured interaction/update budgets, preserve the shared surface-view contracts and create a narrow LWJGL fallback issue with the failed evidence.
